cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 69% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.50% · WTI +0.85% · Brent +0.98% · NatGas +1.38%. 69% of 68 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.67%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Midstream & LNG lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.67%; weakest is Midstream & LNG at -0.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +18.26%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +18.26%, RUN +8.30%, ARRY +4.24%, WFRD +4.08%, SEDG +3.76%. Laggards: BWXT -4.09%, BE -1.30%, EQNR -0.95%, WMB -0.90%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
